_comment: Runtime config for the DoseRAD2026 proton-CT container.
Precedence: built-in default < this file < environment variable.
Measured 2026-08-29 on a reconstructed challenge-size request with 2 images,
3 beams, 106 rays, 244 beamlets, and output slot sizes
dense=6/chunk=32/default compression: 33.847 s, 15.01 GiB reserved
dense=2/chunk=32/default compression: 36.478 s,  6.46 GiB reserved
dense=2/chunk=128/default compression: 37.333 s, 8.90 GiB reserved
dense=4/chunk=128/default compression: 33.840 s, 13.29 GiB reserved
dense=4/chunk=128/compression level 1: 33.228 s then 32.565 s
same settings + 2 parallel output writers: 30.224 s, output stage 5.8 s
compile FP32/default mode + padded tails: 26.362 s repeat invoke
eager FP16/dense=6 + pipelined output: 27.2 s
compile FP16/dense=6/max-autotune + pipelined output: 23.1 s, 9.53 GiB
That direct-call microbenchmark was 31.8% faster than the 33.847 s baseline
but plain max-autotune CUDA graphs later failed through the threaded HTTP server.
The optimizations do not change the
checkpoint, physics, 26x74 trained BEV crop, beamlets, or float32 output format.
Max-autotune warmup took 207 s locally during unmetered health initialization.
Compression is lossless; pipelined outputs were byte-for-byte identical.
Real validation case 1ABB011 beam 9 with FP16: normalized masked MAE 0.003187675,
IDD distance 0.001119222, combined stratified MAE 0.028311623 (slightly better
Measured on the supplied 309-map workload shape (2 images, 3 beams; maps
eager FP16 + pipelined output: 37.06 s, 14.82 GiB reserved
max-autotune-no-cudagraphs:    30.03 s,  9.74 GiB reserved
The HTTP-safe compiled path is 19.0% faster than eager on the same local GPU.
Do not compare its 30.03 s absolute time with the 78 s challenge-server run:
the hardware differs. Applying only the controlled 30.03/37.06 ratio to the
previous 95 s leaderboard projection gives approximately 77 s.
Plain max-autotune is invalid in this FastAPI
server because its CUDA-graph state is thread-local to the health warmup thread.
Across deterministic samples of all ten stacks, compile-vs-eager RMSE was
0.87e-9 to 3.12e-9 with max absolute error <= 1.003e-6. A complete 241.6M-voxel
six-map stack had RMSE 1.620e-9 and max absolute error 1.154e-6.
